entries.a9525b92106c9fde: It sets out "Kyosei (living together)" as its corporate philosophy and operates its business as a community-based real estate company centered on Kobe City, Akashi City, and the Hanshin area. In its mainstay sale of condominiums, it says it will, while making as its basis development in good, highly convenient locations using its community-based advantage, strive to expand its business area to surrounding regions, and advance the strengthening of quality and improvement of services and the provision of diverse plans suited to customers' diversifying lifestyles. As diversification of exit strategies, it also works on the development and sale of small income-producing properties and housing facilities for the elderly, and in the detached house business it will focus on land purchasing and aim to stably secure the number of units supplied annually. In the leasing business, it will seek to improve its rental assets as a whole by maintaining occupancy rates and flexibly replacing properties, and as new businesses it will also work on the development of grid-scale battery storage facilities and non-asset businesses such as renovation and resale brokerage for purchasers of its properties. The theme of its medium-term management plan (fiscal years ending February 2027 to February 2029) is set as "strengthening the resilience of the management base."
